content: Nelly said Its getting hot in here…..The Lakewood Grill is heating UP as more and mroe teams show up for JAMMIN’ Trivia!! 10 teams took the grayiron tonight for some seriously awesome FREE trivia. Seriously, this is ONE FUN VENUE!! If you’re a fan, come on out, if not, come BECOME a fan. the new menu rocks, you GOTS to try the 50/50 burger…half beef and half bacon…ALL YUM!!! And the trivia is off the hook Newbie Diane ran most of the show and lit it up, Colorado style. When it was all said and did, Romany won the honors and pulled in two free pitchers, just fer being lurned!! See everyone next Tuesday at 6:30 for JAMMIN’ Trivia!!
